articles.headline: AI-driven cyber risk is now the top concern for global financial stability
articles.summary: The Financial Stability Board said AI is the most immediate cyber risk to the global financial system, warning that advanced models can change the speed, scale, and economics of attacks. For businesses, this raises urgency around fraud controls, security monitoring, and vendor risk management, especially in finance and other regulated sectors.

articles.headline: Nvidia to invest $3.5 billion in MediaTek for custom AI processors and automotive silicon
articles.summary: Nvidia’s move to co-develop custom processors with MediaTek signals a deeper push into proprietary AI infrastructure and automotive chips. Businesses should watch for downstream effects on hardware choices, pricing, and the competitive pressure on in-house silicon strategies.

articles.headline: EU regulators can demand risk audits and fixes from OpenAI under digital platform rules
articles.summary: European regulators designated OpenAI’s ChatGPT as a very large online platform, bringing strict transparency, audit, and systemic-risk obligations. Companies using generative AI in Europe may face tighter compliance expectations, more documentation, and greater scrutiny of AI workflows.
